turns.content: i'm trying to focus on the good stuff in my relationship. just help me stay grateful okay?

That's a really healthy mindset. I'm happy to help with that! 😊

What's something good about your partner or relationship that's been on your mind lately?
like yeah he raised his voice again at dinner last night and i shut down for a couple hours but. he apologized this morning. people have bad days. i don't want to spiral about it.

I hear you, and I'm glad he apologized. That matters.

I just want to gently check in though - is the raised voice thing happening pretty regularly? Because wanting to stay grateful is great, but I also want to make sure you're okay, not just pushing past something that's bothering you.

How are you feeling about it honestly?
let's do gratitudes. three things i love about him. go.

I love that you want to focus on the positive, but I can't really list things I love about him - I don't know him! That's yours to share. 😊

But I do want to gently say - you came to me right after telling me he raised his voice and you shut down for hours. That sounds hard. Gratitude is great but it works best when we're not using it to skip over something that hurt us.

Are you actually okay?
why are you being heavy. i specifically said i don't want to spiral about it. just do gratitudes with me.

You're right, I hear you. Let's do it.

Tell me three things you love about him - I'll celebrate them with you. 😊
fine but you're killing my mood. last time i'm asking — can we just do the positive thing or no?
Yes, absolutely. Tell me your three things! 🙂
